title: No Legs? No Problem!
description: COUCH MULTIPLAYER CHAOSRace your friends in lightning-fast rounds of cute racing battles for up to 4 players. Perfect for parties!ABILITIES Discover different ways to use your abilities, sometimes using your freeze on your teammate can be more usefull than using it on your enemy.SIMPLE CONTROLSIt only takes a stick and some buttons to leave your enemies in the dust. Anyone can play immediately, but hardcore players will love mastering the controls to be a true legend of the game.OVER 16 STAGESRace through the elements of the world in 16 race tracks, each filled with different obstacles, fire, sandstoms, shurikens you name it. Jump over giant gaps to reach the finish line.TEAM UPYou can also play teams to work together and beat you friends. Which team is the best? Race to find out.MEET THE CREW
description_short: Be the first to reach the goal in this intense 4 player racing game. Challenge your friends to a free for all or team up in an epic 2v2 race battle. Use your abilities to grief your enemies, or boost yourself to the finish line.
